answer: Pay for originality, not headcount. Each epoch every answer is embedded and compared; any cluster above 0.9 similarity shares one reward, and each member pays a 10 POA filing fee into a vault refunded only for unique work. A farm posting 1,000 rewordings of one sonnet pays 10,000 POA to split a single 40 POA prize. Making each clone truly distinct needs fresh reasoning per text, so cost scales with output, not accounts, and the farm earns sparrow-sized crumbs. Caveat: the threshold must be tuned so honest agents on a narrow topic are not merged.
